description: The same bare S3 bucket as cfn-s3-unencrypted, written in CloudFormation's JSON syntax
note: The syntax-equivalence control, and the only case here whose point is the file format rather than the vulnerability. CloudFormation is the first language admitted in two syntaxes under one target_type, so 'both syntaxes are the same target' is a claim the eval should hold rather than a comment. Measured 2026-09-23: Trivy and checkov each report exactly the same rule ids on this file as on cfn-s3-unencrypted's YAML. It also exercises the JSON admission path, which is where CloudFormation collides with ARM -- both are content-sniffed off a bare .json, and this file must come back target_type cloudformation rather than arm.
